title: TXA：时间与方案
TXA: timing and regimen
anchor: ≤3 h；1 g 静滴 ≥10 min → 1 g 静脉维持 8 h
≤3 h; 1 g IV over ≥10 min → 1 g IV over 8 h
scope: 成人创伤活动/疑似严重出血；从受伤起算。
Adults with active/suspected major traumatic bleeding; time from injury.
decision: 尽早使用；国内 R33 维持表述为“8 h以上”，欧洲 R23 为8 h。
Give early; Chinese R33 states at least eight hours for maintenance, European R23 eight hours.
upgrade: 超3 h、疑纤溶关闭或特殊人群：交由团队按来源与本院规范重新判断。
After three hours, possible fibrinolytic shutdown or special populations: source/local-policy review.
comparisonNote: 按本院药品说明书、配制及输注流程执行；不得快速静推。
Follow local product, preparation and infusion policy; avoid rapid IV push.

title: 成人出血：血压目标
Adult bleeding: BP target
scope: 止血前、无颅脑/脊髓损伤的成人初期出血。
Early adult bleeding before control, without brain/spinal injury.
decision: 老年、慢性高血压慎重；儿童与孕妇另按专门方案。
Caution with older age/chronic hypertension; separate pediatric/pregnancy protocols.
upgrade: 灌注持续恶化或合并神经损伤：重新定目标并升级止血。
Worsening perfusion or neurological injury: revise targets and escalate bleeding control.
comparisonNote: 国内R22与欧洲R13支持有条件的目标；不是所有伤者通用。
Chinese R22 / European R13 support conditional use, not a universal target.

title: 休克指数
Shock index
scope: 成人风险识别，结合查体与趋势。
Adult risk recognition, with examination and trends.
decision: 国内R2将≥1列入诊断条件；欧洲R5讨论0.9–1附近风险。
Chinese R2 includes ≥1 in diagnostic criteria; European R5 discusses risk around 0.9–1.
upgrade: 药物抑制心率或老人“正常”生命体征仍保留休克担心。
Blunted HR or apparently normal older-adult vitals do not exclude shock.
comparisonNote: 不凭单个指数排除出血或决定输血。
Do not use SI alone to exclude bleeding or decide transfusion.

title: 大量输血启动评估
MTP activation assessment
scope: 成人；ACS TQIP 评分示例。
Adults; ACS TQIP example.
decision: 穿透躯干伤、FAST阳性、HR >120、SBP <90各1分；核对本院版本。
One point each: penetrating torso, positive FAST, HR >120, SBP <90; verify local version.
upgrade: 持续不稳定或活动出血需止血也可触发评估，不等累计输血量。
Persistent instability/active bleeding may also trigger assessment; do not wait for cumulative volume.
comparisonNote: 国内支持早期血液管理与本院流程；未据此声称ABC为全国统一启动标准。
Chinese guidance supports early blood/local policy; ABC is not claimed as a national activation rule.

title: 纤维蛋白原
Fibrinogen
scope: 严重活动出血，或黏弹性检测提示功能性缺乏。
Major active bleeding or viscoelastic evidence of functional deficit.
decision: 欧洲R29：评估纤维蛋白原/冷沉淀补充并复测。
European R29: assess fibrinogen/cryo replacement and retest.
upgrade: 出血持续、检测恶化：血库/凝血团队按本院方案升级。
Ongoing bleeding/worsening tests: blood-bank/coagulation escalation.
comparisonNote: 国内围术期共识：严重渗血冷沉淀条款为<1.5，纤维蛋白原条款为<1.5–2.0；场景及边界不同。
Chinese perioperative consensus uses <1.5 for cryo in severe oozing and <1.5–2.0 for fibrinogen; scope/operators differ.

title: 输血时 Hb 目标
Hb target during transfusion
scope: 成人创伤，需要红细胞输注时的欧洲R16目标。
European R16 target for adult trauma requiring RBC transfusion.
decision: 结合活动出血、灌注与病程；早期Hb正常不能排除大出血。
Use bleeding/perfusion/trajectory; normal early Hb does not exclude hemorrhage.
upgrade: TBI、心肌缺血及特殊人群按专科目标；不等Hb下降才启动抢救。
TBI, myocardial ischemia and special populations need specific goals; do not await Hb fall.
comparisonNote: 国内2025用血规范要求个体评估与输后评价，不能据其声称全国统一70–90目标。
Chinese 2025 blood-use standard requires individual assessment/response review, not a national 70–90 target.

title: 离子钙
Ionized calcium
anchor: iCa：维持本实验室正常范围
iCa: maintain the local normal range
scope: 成人大出血，尤其大量输血。
Adult major bleeding, especially massive transfusion.
decision: 复测血气iCa并结合pH，按本院补钙方案纠正。
Recheck blood-gas iCa with pH; correct under local replacement policy.
upgrade: 输血仍在进行、iCa下降或心律变化：及时团队复评。
Ongoing transfusion, falling iCa or rhythm changes: prompt reassessment.
comparisonNote: 欧洲R31与国内围术期3.8均强调监测/正常化；本页不统一药品或补钙剂量。
European R31 and Chinese perioperative 3.8 support monitoring/normalization; products/doses are local.

title: 重型颅脑伤：灌注目标
Severe TBI: perfusion target
scope: 重型TBI（GCS ≤8）；不能套用允许性低血压。
Severe TBI (GCS ≤8); avoid permissive hypotension.
decision: 国内2023 R22另列SBP >110；2026院前R6写SBP ≥110或MAP ≥80。
Chinese 2023 R22 also gives SBP >110; 2026 prehospital R6 gives SBP ≥110 or MAP ≥80.
upgrade: 意识/瞳孔变化、目标未达：同步纠正氧合/灌注并升级神经救治。
Changing consciousness/pupils or unmet goals: address oxygenation/perfusion and escalate neurological care.
comparisonNote: 已有ICP监测时结合CPP等个体目标；MAP不是完整神经监护方案。
With ICP monitoring, individualize CPP and other goals; MAP is not a complete neurocritical protocol.

title: 老年：提早警惕隐匿休克
Older adults: occult shock warning
scope: 老年创伤高风险识别/分诊提示，不等于单独确诊休克。
Older-trauma high-risk triage signal, not a stand-alone shock diagnosis.
decision: 补问抗凝、基线功能、降压/控心率药及头部受伤。
Ask about anticoagulants, baseline function, BP/HR drugs and head injury.
upgrade: 低能量伤合并症状、抗凝或灌注异常：提早高级评估。
Low-energy injury with symptoms, anticoagulation or poor perfusion: early senior review.
comparisonNote: 110阈值源于重伤院前共识；髋部指南仅作国内骨科后续路径入口。
The 110 signal comes from prehospital consensus; hip guidance is a domestic orthopedic pathway entry.

title: 抗凝药：识别后逆转路径
Anticoagulants: reversal pathway
anchor: 药名 → 末次剂量 → 出血严重度
scope: 危及生命/不可控出血或紧急高风险手术；由授权团队决策。
Life-threatening/uncontrolled bleeding or urgent high-risk surgery; authorized team decisions.
decision: 华法林：PCC + 静脉维K；达比加群：依达赛珠单抗；Xa药：特异拮抗剂或PCC路径。
Warfarin: PCC + IV vitamin K; dabigatran: idarucizumab; Xa agents: specific reversal or PCC pathway.
upgrade: 同步查肾功能、INR/TT/抗Xa及本院药品可及性；正常PT不能排除DOAC效应。
Check renal function, INR/TT/anti-Xa and formulary; normal PT does not exclude DOAC effect.
comparisonNote: Xa具体药物、适应证与可及性按本院药事/血库方案核对；不对每名服药者自动逆转。
Verify Xa agent, indication and availability locally; reversal is not automatic for every treated patient.

title: 孕妇创伤：母体与产科并行
Pregnancy trauma: maternal/obstetric care
anchor: 母体优先；子宫左推；Rh D
Mother first; left uterine displacement; Rh D
scope: 子宫增大至脐水平/以上；Rh阴性且未致敏的腹部/重大创伤。
Uterus at/above umbilicus; unsensitized Rh-negative abdominal/major trauma.
decision: 有效按压同时人工左推；抗D由产科按孕周、致敏状态、胎母出血与本院方案评估。
Manual displacement with effective CPR; obstetric anti-D assessment by gestation, sensitization, FMH and local policy.
upgrade: 母体不稳定、腹痛/流血或胎心担心：创伤—产科共同升级。
Instability, pain/bleeding or fetal concern: trauma/obstetric escalation.
comparisonNote: 尚未核实覆盖这些具体条款的国内同等指南；保留国际参考标识，本院产科流程确认。
No equivalent Chinese guidance for these specific items was verified; international reference, local obstetric confirmation.

title: 孕妇心停：复苏性分娩
Pregnancy arrest: resuscitative delivery
anchor: 识别心停即准备；目标 ≤5 min 完成
Prepare at arrest recognition; goal delivery by ≤5 min
scope: 子宫底在脐水平/以上且标准复苏未获ROSC。
Fundus at/above umbilicus with no ROSC despite standard resuscitation.
decision: AHA2025：在心停现场组织产科/麻醉/新生儿团队与复苏性分娩。
AHA 2025: organize obstetric/anesthetic/neonatal teams and resuscitative delivery at the arrest site.
upgrade: 传统4 min启动/5 min娩出是历史时间框架；不等4 min才叫人或准备。
Historical four-minute start/five-minute birth framing does not mean waiting four minutes to call or prepare.
comparisonNote: 本院需预先落实团队、物资与演练；不是所有孕周的自动手术指令。
Pre-plan teams, equipment and drills locally; not an automatic operation at every gestation.

title: 儿童：体重与首轮复苏
Children: weight and first aliquot
anchor: 实测/近期体重；晶体液 10 mL/kg
scope: RCH儿童重大创伤，循环不足的首轮等渗液体评估；并行识别出血。
RCH major pediatric trauma with poor circulation; assess bleeding in parallel.
decision: 无法称重按本院验证的身长体重工具；RCH持续出血可用RBC 10 mL/kg初始小份。
If unweighable use a locally validated length-based tool; RCH ongoing bleeding: initial RBC aliquot 10 mL/kg.
upgrade: 每份后复评；持续失血尽早血库/儿科MTP，不重复大量晶体液。
Reassess each aliquot; ongoing hemorrhage needs blood-bank/pediatric MTP, avoiding repeated large crystalloids.
comparisonNote: 国内重症失血性休克成分方案见下一卡；常规RBC 10–15表不适用于急救大出血。
Chinese major-hemorrhage component regimen is on the next card; routine RBC table excludes emergency major bleeding.

title: 儿童：国内失血性休克输血索引
Children: Chinese hemorrhagic transfusion index
scope: WS/T795—2022 §9.5.2.2：儿童创伤性失血性休克。

decision: 标准举例RBC 20 mL/kg + FFP 20 mL/kg；不是常规贫血或非创伤比例。
Standard example: RBC 20 mL/kg + FFP 20 mL/kg; not routine anemia/non-trauma ratio.

Persistent bleeding: additional components under standard/local MTP; adjust to labs and monitor overload.
comparisonNote: 此为成分容量方案示例，与RCH首轮小份的阶段不同；核对产品规格和本院儿童流程。
A component-volume regimen, at a different stage from RCH initial aliquots; check product/local pediatric policy.

title: 烧伤：中国新九分法
Burns: Chinese rule of nines
scope: 头面颈、双上肢、躯干含会阴、双下肢含臀足。
Head/face/neck; both arms; trunk including perineum; both legs including buttocks/feet.
decision: Under 12: head/neck=9+(12−age)%; both legs=46−(12−age)%.
upgrade: 面积或深度不确定、关键部位/吸入/电化学伤：烧伤专科复评。
Uncertain area/depth, key-site/inhalation/electrical/chemical injury: burn review.
comparisonNote: 按2025版规范表1及§2.1；补液面积只计Ⅱ/Ⅲ度，不将Ⅰ度纳入。
2025 standard Table 1 / §2.1; fluid-formula area uses second/third degree, excluding superficial burns.

title: 烧伤：国内成人补液公式
Burns: Chinese adult fluid formula
scope: 国内2025规范晶胶混合公式；Ⅱ/Ⅲ度，%填百分数数值。
Chinese 2025 crystalloid/colloid formula; second/third degree; enter percentage number.
decision: 晶:胶=1–2:1；总估算量一半在伤后首8 h，余量分后两个8 h。
Crystalloid:colloid=1–2:1; half estimated total in first eight hours from injury, quarters in next two intervals.
upgrade: 按灌注、尿量和过负荷反馈调整；成人公式不套儿童/心肾病。
Titrate to perfusion, urine and overload; do not apply adult formula to children/cardiorenal disease.
comparisonNote: 1.5是该版范围下限，不是唯一固定量；已输入液体计入总量，以本院烧伤流程为准。
1.5 is the lower end, not a fixed universal amount; include prior fluids and follow local burn policy.

title: 抢救、告知与交接文书
Resuscitation, consent and handover records
anchor: 抢救结束后 ≤6 h 据实补记并注明
Truthful, marked supplementation ≤6 h after rescue ends
scope: 仅限因抢救急危患者未能及时书写；不是所有病历可延迟。
Only when urgent rescue prevented timely writing; not permission to delay all records.
decision: 时间到分钟；措施、反应、人员、告知与交接责任。

upgrade: 签署困难记录原因并走合法授权/急救审批流程，不造签名或回填时间。
Record signing difficulties and use lawful emergency authorization; never fabricate signatures/times.
comparisonNote: 病历规范第22条(八)、25/27条；输血告知同步遵循2025用血规范。
Record norms Article 22(8), 25/27; transfusion consent also follows 2025 blood-use standards.
